title: Gulf Breeze | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 6 Seater Golf Cart Included!* Resort-Style Community Pool Featuring Waterfalls and Tropical Vibes* Beach Access - Just 1 Mile Away* Covered Patio for Relaxing* Two Separate Living Areas- Plenty of Room for Everyone!
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 6 Seater Golf Cart Included!* Resort-Style Community Pool Featuring Waterfalls and Tropical Vibes* Beach Access - Just 1 Mile Away* Covered Patio for Relaxing* Two Separate Living Areas- Plenty of Room for Everyone!* Convenient Location: Close to dining and entertainment at Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place.* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions. * Welcome to Gulf Breeze, where coastal living meets resort-style comfort in the gated community of Cypress Breeze Plantation. This light-filled 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers a bright and airy atmosphere, with natural light flowing throughout and a covered patio that seamlessly extends your living space outdoors—perfect for morning coffee or unwinding after a day at the beach. Inside, you’ll find a well-equipped kitchen ready for everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners, along with inviting living spaces designed for relaxation and connection. Guests will also enjoy access to the community’s resort-style pool, complete with waterfalls and lush tropical landscaping. The home comfortably accommodates 11 guests with a thoughtfully designed layout and a living space on each floor. Gulf Breeze is the perfect blend of comfort, style, and coastal charm—ideal for your next getaway.The Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Master Bedroom: Queen Bed 2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed Guest Bedroom 2: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed and Twin-over-Full Bunk BedGuest Bedroom 3: Queen BedArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
